questions.q: How many marks is the Listening paper worth, and how long is it (not counting reading time)?
questions.why: Paper 1 is 40 marks, 30 minutes plus 5 minutes reading time, and is 25% of the qualification.
Q7 is the extended writing task with four bullet points (choice of three); Q6 is 60–75 words.

questions.q: Which sub-topic can NOT be used for your Speaking picture?
questions.why: A3, C3, C5, D2 and E4 are not assessed in Speaking.

questions.q: Describe what you should do in the 5 minutes of reading time in the Listening paper, and how to use the two playings.
questions.model: Read all the questions, underline the question words, and predict the kind of answer (number, time, opinion). On the first playing answer what you can; on the second check and fill gaps, and never leave a blank.
points: Reads all questions and underlines the question words / predicts answer type
Answers on first play, checks and fills gaps on second
Does not leave blanks (no penalty for guessing)
